exposure: Borderline amniotic fluid index (AFI) (5.1 ≤ AFI ≤ 8.0 cm)
outcome: Cesarean delivery for non-reassuring fetal heart rate testing
Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
finding: In uncomplicated term pregnancies, a borderline amniotic fluid index was not associated with an increased risk of adverse perinatal outcomes, except for a higher rate of small for gestational age infants.
mod_finding: Borderline amniotic fluid index (AFI) in uncomplicated term pregnancies was not associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery for non-reassuring fetal heart rate testing.
